annotations.title: Move a record through a view's action

description: Moves one record one step along a view's own action buttons — move is one of the view's declared actions (dev_view/live_view's rows list each row's own open moves). In Development it is done at once. In Live (env live) it asks the founder to approve it in their browser — the page reads the move, the field it writes and the record's own current value against Live right then ("Cancel" on todays-bookings: status pending → cancelled), never a bare record id — and approving it carries out exactly that, once (live_action_status with wait: true reads the outcome; the record moving again before they approve refuses approval_plan_changed, never a stale move). Refused when the move isn't declared on this view, or the record's current state isn't one the move starts from (another move already won). This is what a founder may call moving a card, changing a row's status, or pressing a view's button.

move.description: one of the view's own action names

note.description: Live only: one line for your human, why
